AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain General Animal Health and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Beekeeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Rearing Project 3.0 Agricultural Technologies and Entrepreneurship 3.1 To and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Rearing Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. C — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.
